subject: Vendor onboarding: COI & PO setup for Cypress Data — procurement kickoff
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Priya Raj <priya.raj@cypressdata.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-03T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: COI & PO setup for Cypress Data — procurement kickoff

Hi Priya —

Thanks for partnering with Redwood Inference. I’m the procurement lead handling vendor setup for Cypress Data. To get started and create a PO, can you please provide the following items this week if possible: 

- COI (Certificates of Insurance) covering: General Liability (min $1,000,000), E&O/Professional Liability (min $1,000,000), and Cyber/Privacy (min $2,000,000).
- Policy names, carrier, policy numbers, effective/expiration dates, and any retroactive date for E&O/cyber.
- W-9 (vendor tax form) and your legal company name for vendor code.
- Completed vendor onboarding form (I’ve attached the stub) and preferred remit-to details.

Please upload the certificates and forms to our procurement portal: https://redwood.procurement.portal/vendor-onboarding/CYP-789 and reply here with expected timing. If you prefer, you can attach PDFs to this thread.

Once we receive the items and legal completes a quick review, finance will issue a PO. If you anticipate any coverage gaps (e.g., different limits or additional insured endorsements), flag them now and we’ll loop legal.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth kickoff.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form_stub.pdf (PDF, 45 KB)]

From: Priya Raj <priya.raj@cypressdata.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-04T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: COI & PO setup for Cypress Data — procurement kickoff

Neha —

Appreciate the checklist. Attaching our current insurance certificates and the W-9. Summary below:

- GL Certificate: Carrier: Sterling Mutual; Policy #: GL-44521; Limits: $1,000,000 each occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate.
- E&O Certificate: Carrier: Harbor Insurance; Policy #: EO-99827; Limits: $1,000,000 per claim; Retroactive date: 2018-08-01.
- Cyber Coverage (summary): Carrier: CloudSure; Limits: $1,000,000; awaiting formal certificate — insurer advised they can issue $2M but need 48 hours to bind.

I’ve attached: Cypress_COI_GL_20251003.pdf, Cypress_EO_Certificate_20251003.pdf, and our W-9 (Cypress_W9_20251003.pdf). I’ll follow up once the insurer confirms the $2M cyber certificate.

If you need endorsements (additional insured / waiver of subrogation), let me know and I’ll request them from our carriers.

Thanks,
Priya Raj
Head of Vendor Ops | Cypress Data Inc.
[Attachments: Cypress_COI_GL_20251003.pdf (PDF, 120 KB); Cypress_EO_Certificate_20251003.pdf (PDF, 95 KB); Cypress_W9_20251003.pdf (PDF, 60 KB)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-05T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Vendor onboarding: COI & PO setup for Cypress Data — procurement kickoff

Looping in legal and finance — quick questions after Neha’s initial ask and Priya’s files: 

1) Monica: can you confirm whether the E&O certificate language is sufficient for our standard vendor agreement? Specifically:
   - Do we require Cypress to list Redwood Inference as an Additional Insured on the GL certificate? (we typically do for third-party vendors)
   - For E&O, do we need a proof of limits plus full policy wording or is the certificate OK?

2) Finance/Laura: once legal signs off, can you confirm the vendor code and expected time to issue a PO? Finance typically needs the W-9 + vendor profile; do we need a contract signed before issuing PO for subscription services?

Priya — appreciate the quick turnaround. If cyber can be bound at $2M within 48 hours that should be fine; if not, we’ll evaluate risk and possible mitigations.

Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(On behalf of Customer Success)

> On Oct 4, 2025, Priya Raj <priya.raj@cypressdata.com> wrote:
> Neha —
> 
> Appreciated the checklist. Attaching our current insurance certificates and the W-9...

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-06T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: COI & PO setup for Cypress Data — procurement kickoff

Thanks for the loop. I reviewed the GL and E&O certs Priya attached. High-level comments: 

- GL: certificate shows required limits. We do require Redwood Inference to be listed as Additional Insured for General Liability where the contract covers third-party liability. Please request an endorsement (CG 20 10 or equivalent) naming "Redwood Inference, its officers, employees and agents" as Additional Insured.

- E&O: certificate indicates $1M limits and a 2018 retro date — acceptable for now. We typically ask for either (a) the full policy declarations page or (b) a broker letter confirming no exclusions for breach response and that retroactive date applies to all claims. Please ask Cypress to provide one of those.

- Cyber: current summary is 1M; Cisco requires $2M for vendors processing production data. If Cypress can bind $2M, we need the certificate showing limits and the retroactive date for incident coverage. If not, provide evidence of a formal plan (MDR provider contract, incident response SLA) and we’ll consider additional contractual mitigations.

- Delivery: please have the vendor upload endorsements/certificates to the procurement portal. If they cannot produce endorsements quickly, we can accept a carrier binder plus a promise to deliver the endorsement prior to PO/payment.

I’ll draft a brief insurance rider to include in our SOW that captures the Additional Insured language and cyber threshold.

Monica Patel
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
[Internal note: will add a clause for cyber incident notification 72 hours and data breach cooperation]

From: Priya Raj <priya.raj@cypressdata.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: "Cypress Finance" <finance@cypressdata.com>
Date: 2025-10-07T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: COI & PO setup for Cypress Data — procurement kickoff

Rishi / Neha / Monica —

Thanks for the feedback and for outlining the next steps. Quick update: our broker confirmed they can issue the $2M cyber certificate and the Additional Insured endorsement for GL; attached are the newly issued files and our completed W-9. We uploaded the same to your portal under CYP-789.

Attachments included: Cypress_Cyber_Insurance_20251007.pdf (Cyber certificate, $2,000,000), Cypress_COI_GL_20251003.pdf (updated with endorsement), Cypress_EO_Certificate_20251003.pdf, Cypress_W9_20251007.pdf.

Next steps from our side: please confirm once legal signs off on the rider and finance issues the PO / vendor code. We can begin provisioning once we have the PO in place. If you need any more documents from carriers (e.g., full policy wording), tell me and I’ll ask the broker.

Best,
Priya Raj
Head of Vendor Ops | Cypress Data Inc.
